## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A seven-juan Northern Sòng sub-commentary by Chángshuǐ Zǐxuán 長水子璿 (965–1038) on [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Zōngmì's (780–841) *Jīngāng jīng shūlùn zuǎnyào* 金剛般若經疏論纂要 ([KR6c0041](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0041)). The work provides extensive sub-commentarial elucidation of Zōngmì's Tang-period *Vajracchedikā* commentary, with particular attention to the textual-critical "establishment-and-cutting" (*kāndìng* 刊定) of variant readings and editorial decisions. Preserved at T33 no. 1702.

**Abstract**

Authorship: by Zǐxuán 子璿 (965–1038), the principal Sòng-period editorial-redactor of Zōngmì's commentarial corpus. *notBefore* = 990, *notAfter* = 1038.

The work is the substantive sub-commentary companion to Zǐxuán's structural-extract [KR6c0040](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0040) and his editorial-redaction work on Zōngmì's *Vajracchedikā* commentary [KR6c0041](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0041). Together the three works constitute Zǐxuán's complete editorial-and-commentarial intervention in the Zōngmì *Vajracchedikā* tradition.
